Control options for score plots

Source: R/plot_controls.R
score_plot_control.Rd

Creates a control list for the appearance of plots produced by plot.dp_score(), including grouped score plots. Score plots are constructed with ggplot2 and combined with patchwork.

Usage

score_plot_control(
  color = "#6A5ACD",
  scatter_alpha = 0.6,
  scatter_size = 1.8,
  hist_alpha_range = c(0, 1),
  base_size = 12,
  title_size = 14,
  scatter_title = "Non-Private Scatter",
  nonprivate_title = "Non-Private Histogram",
  add_title = "Add DP Histogram",
  sparse_title = "Sparse DP Histogram",
  xlab = NULL,
  ylab = NULL,
  group_colors = NULL,
  group_ncol = 3L,
  show_group_legend = TRUE
)

Arguments

color

Single color used for non-group score plots. The default is "#6A5ACD".

scatter_alpha

Number in [0, 1] controlling point transparency in non-private and sampled scatter panels. The default is 0.6.

scatter_size

Positive number controlling point size in non-private and sampled scatter panels. The default is 1.8.

hist_alpha_range

Numeric vector of length 2 giving the minimum and maximum alpha values used for histogram cells. Values must satisfy 0 <= hist_alpha_range[1] <= hist_alpha_range[2] <= 1. The default is c(0, 1).

base_size

Positive base font size for score plots. The default is 12.

title_size

Positive plot-title font size. The default is 14.

scatter_title

Optional title for the non-private scatter panel. The default is "Non-Private Scatter".

nonprivate_title

Optional title for the non-private histogram panel. The default is "Non-Private Histogram".

add_title

Optional title for the additive private histogram panel. The default is "Add DP Histogram".

sparse_title

Optional title for the sparse private histogram panel. The default is "Sparse DP Histogram".

xlab

Optional x-axis label. If NULL, the selected PC name is used.

ylab

Optional y-axis label. If NULL, the selected PC name is used.

group_colors

Optional nonempty character vector of colors for grouped score plots. Named colors are matched to group labels; missing groups receive generated colors. Unnamed colors are recycled in group order. If NULL, valid color labels are used directly, otherwise a palette is generated automatically.

group_ncol

Positive integer retained for backward compatibility. Grouped score plots are currently overlaid by group color rather than arranged as separate group-specific panels, so this option is not used by plot.dp_score(). The default is 3.

show_group_legend

Logical value indicating whether to display the group legend in grouped score plots. The default is TRUE. In combined grouped displays, each histogram method uses one legend; standalone panels retain their own legends. Groups with no sampled points are omitted from sampled-point legends.

Value

A list of plotting options for plot.dp_score().

Examples

score_plot_control()
#> $color
#> [1] "#6A5ACD"
#> 
#> $scatter_alpha
#> [1] 0.6
#> 
#> $scatter_size
#> [1] 1.8
#> 
#> $hist_alpha_range
#> [1] 0 1
#> 
#> $base_size
#> [1] 12
#> 
#> $title_size
#> [1] 14
#> 
#> $scatter_title
#> [1] "Non-Private Scatter"
#> 
#> $nonprivate_title
#> [1] "Non-Private Histogram"
#> 
#> $add_title
#> [1] "Add DP Histogram"
#> 
#> $sparse_title
#> [1] "Sparse DP Histogram"
#> 
#> $xlab
#> NULL
#> 
#> $ylab
#> NULL
#> 
#> $group_colors
#> NULL
#> 
#> $group_ncol
#> [1] 3
#> 
#> $show_group_legend
#> [1] TRUE
#> 

score_plot_control(
  scatter_size = 2.2,
  title_size = 13,
  nonprivate_title = "Non-Private score histogram"
)
#> $color
#> [1] "#6A5ACD"
#> 
#> $scatter_alpha
#> [1] 0.6
#> 
#> $scatter_size
#> [1] 2.2
#> 
#> $hist_alpha_range

#>

#> 
#> $add_title
#> [1] "Add DP Histogram"
#> 
#> $sparse_title
#> [1] "Sparse DP Histogram"
#> 
#> $xlab
#> NULL
#> 
#> $ylab
#> NULL
#> 
#> $group_colors
#> NULL
#>

#> [1] 3
